messages:
Marta R: CI failing on main - SAST job can't decrypt scan artifact, looks like KMS permission denied after yesterday's RBAC cleanup.
Joel: :eyes: build link https://ci.redwood.example/1234
CI-bot: build #1234 failed in job 'sast-scan' — exit 1 — decrypt error: AccessDenied
Samir: which key? logs show key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abc-123
Marta R: yes that's the key used by sast-runner-sa. Error lines: "User is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt"
Lia: I removed 'kms:Decrypt' from scanner role in RBAC cleanup PR 8723 to tighten scope — I didn't expect the CI runners to still rely on that service account.
Joel: can we avoid reverting by giving decrypt to the ephemeral role the runner assumes? pattern: sts:AssumeRole -> ephemeral creds -> grant.
Samir: short-term options: 1) revert PR 8723 2) re-add kms:Decrypt to scanner role 3) create a limited KMS grant for the assumed role (preferred).
Marta R: I'll create a grant for the CI assumed role to minimize long-term policy changes.
Marta R: snippet I'll run: 
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id abc-123 --grantee-principal arn:aws:sts::111122223333:assumed-role/ci-runner/123 --operations Decrypt --name "sast-ci-temp" --constraints '{"EncryptionContextSubset":{"job":"sast"}}'
```
Samir: perfect — grants expire when revoked and don't change key policy. After that restart runners so they pick up ability to decrypt.
CI-bot: note: scanner caches decrypted blobs for performance; restarting runners ensures clean state.
Lia: I'll open PR to rollback 8723 as a fallback that can be merged if the grant approach fails. @Marta R — want me to land it?
Marta R: yes, please keep it ready but don't merge unless we have to. I'll patch infra test too.
Samir: long-term: add a pre-merge RBAC smoke test that performs a harmless test decrypt against the key used by SAST so RBAC PRs fail fast.
Joel: add to postmortem: list of affected builds, who merged 8723, key policy diff, and recommended remediation (grant pattern + infra test). Who owns?
Marta R: I'll own the incident ticket and timeline. Creating ticket now.
security-bot: Created incident INC-2026-034 for 'SAST CI decrypt failures after RBAC cleanup' assigned to Marta R
Marta R: CloudTrail query: look for kms:Decrypt Denied between 2026-03-20T12:00:00Z and 2026-03-20T12:22:00Z — I'll attach traces to the ticket.
Lia: found entries, attaching screenshot to INC-2026-034 and tagging @sec-reviewers.
Joel: After resolution, let's add an automated check to infra/ci that runs: 
```
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://smalltest.enc --key-id abc-123 --encryption-context job=sast
```
Samir: also propose building a keystore-proxy service for short-lived grants to avoid key policy churn.
Marta R: I'm applying the grant now and will restart runners, update in ~10m.
CI-bot: build #1235 started (sast retry)
Joel: :thumbsup:
Marta R: build #1235 passed SAST. Closing incident after ticket write-up and linking remediation PRs.
security-bot: Incident INC-2026-034 updated: status = resolved.
